title: Collage crossing labels classify enriched fixed-end transformations
statement:
Use the universes, quasicategories, coherent functors and transformations of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the space-valued coherent Hom bifunctor of [lem-coef-infinity-hom-bifunctor-functoriality], the space category of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], the enriched tensor/cotensor adjunction of [lem-coef-enriched-category-tensor-calculus], and the collage of [lem-coef-space-bimodule-collage]. Let $\mathcal V$ be a presentably closed symmetric monoidal infinity-category and $\mathcal E$ a complete $\mathcal V$-category, $S$ a small infinity-category, $v\in\mathcal V$, and $P,Q:S\to U\mathcal E$ coherent diagrams. The enriched composition and units of $\mathcal E$ make $(x,y)\mapsto\mathcal E(x,y)$ a coherent functor $(U\mathcal E)^{\mathrm{op}}\times U\mathcal E\to\mathcal V$ whose actions are precomposition and postcomposition, with all unit and composition simplices; this is part of the assertion. Put $H_v(x,y)=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal V}(v,\mathcal E(x,y))$, the composite of this functor with the coherent Hom bifunctor of $\mathcal V$ at $v$, and let $C_v=\operatorname{Coll}(H_v)$ with source and target endpoint copies $(U\mathcal E)_0,(U\mathcal E)_1$. Then the mixed fixed-end mapping space in the collage is naturally equivalent to the enriched transformation space:
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(S,C_v)}(P_0,Q_1)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal V}\bigl(v,\mathcal E^S(P,Q)\bigr).$$
Under the tensor/cotensor adjunction, the right side is the space of coherent enriched maps $T_v\otimes S_{\mathcal V}\to\mathcal E$ with endpoint diagrams $P$ and $Q$, where $T_v$ is the completion of the free algebroid on two fixed objects and one generating edge labeled by $v$, as in [lem-coef-algebroid-presentability]. The equivalence sends a map to its crossing labels in $H_v(Ps,Qt)$ and sends compatible labels back to the unique mixed-string map. It is natural in $v,S,P,Q$, in coherent maps of endpoint diagrams, and in additional space-valued parameters; it retains every higher coherence simplex.
